WoW: Forever · Updated October 31, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70707 · Null Ossuary

Written for levelling, 1 to 60. The beta closed on October 23 at level 30, so nothing above 30 was tested by players; talents and spells past 30 come from the launch client and Blizzard's posts. These pages follow the hotfix Blizzard pushed to the launch realms on October 30, read from the game's hotfix data. Blizzard has not announced it, so it may still move before November 4. Where a spell's tooltip disagrees with the text here, trust the text: tooltips can lag behind a hotfix. Ability training levels below come from foreverchanges.pro's reading of the launch client. Caster base damage was cut across the board and spell coefficients raised to compensate, so a lower tooltip number than Classic is usually not a nerf. Neither Wowhead nor ClassicWoW.gg publishes a levelling score for the three specs. Icy Veins is the only one of the three that rates them, giving each a number out of five and a heading; those appear on each spec's own page.

The three specs do different things, and Blizzard frames the pick as three answers to the same weakness: "Arcane to manipulate and consume Mana for more damage. Fire to produce devastatingly heavy hits and critical damage. Or Frost to grant levels of combat control still unrivaled by any other class." Each spec page carries Icy Veins' score and heading.

No source confirms or denies a target cap or damage falloff on Mage area spells in Forever, and Blizzard's deep dive does not mention one either.

The slows attached to area damage were cut hard, and Blizzard says why. Improved BlizzardImproved BlizzardTalentCastInstantAdds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 sec. maxes at 40%, where Classic reached 65%, to stop Frost Mages farming instances, "which was widely used by gold farmers and boosters to disrupt the economy of the game." Cone of ColdCone of ColdLevel 26 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost210 ManaCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration6 secTargets in a cone in front of the caster take 96 to 106 Frost damage and are slowed by 40% for 6 sec. The first 4 targets hit by this cone are slowed by an additional 10% for an additional 3 sec.'s slow was shortened for the same reason, except on the first 4 targets it hits.

Is Mage for you?

Play Mage if you want burst damage from range and can accept cloth armour, no self-heal and a mana bar you have to manage. (Our own reading, not a source's.)

Blizzard's own summary gives both halves. Mages "remain one of the most powerful and resourceful damage dealing classes" and "masters of ranged area damage which is stronger and more varied than any other class". They are also "extremely fragile and die easily if caught in melee combat", and the spec you pick is how you answer that.

New to this class?

Is the rotation simple? The level 20 rotations on the spec pages run five or six steps: a nuke, a freeze, a retreat, a wand finish.

Is it forgiving? No (ours). You have cloth armour, no self-heal, and mana that does not regenerate while you cast.

What carries you while levelling? Conjured drink from level 4 and food from level 6, so you buy neither. PolymorphPolymorphLevel 8 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 4Cast1.5 sec castCost60 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration20 secTransforms the enemy into a sheep, forcing it to wander around for up to 20 sec. While wandering, the sheep cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters. from 8 takes one enemy out of a fight.

Does it need a group? No. Every spec levels solo. The builds published before launch predate the tree rework, so the spec pages mostly carry our own reworked lists, and Arcane adds a dungeon one.

Which race

Read this section in proportion. Race is the smallest choice on this page, well behind spec, gear and knowing your rotation, and no race is a wrong answer for levelling (ours, not a source's). Racials decide things in PvP. The ones that matter there break crowd control: Will of the ForsakenWill of the ForsakenTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration0.1 secInstantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. (Undead, fear, sleep and charm) and Escape ArtistEscape ArtistTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration3 secInstantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec. (Gnome, roots and snares). A free trinket slot is worth more than any damage racial below (ours).

Alliance — Human or Gnome. Human's RuthlessRuthlessTalentCastInstantIncreases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 2%. gives +1% crit to all spells and attacks with any weapon, and The Human SpiritThe Human SpiritTalentCastInstantSpirit increased by 5%. adds 10% Spirit. Neither depends on a weapon type, so pick weapons on their stats: at levelling levels the staff often wins. Gnome brings Expansive MindExpansive MindTalentCastInstantMaximum Mana increased by 5%. and Eureka!Eureka!TalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration8 secYour damaging abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec.. Eureka!Eureka!TalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration8 secYour damaging abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec. is an 8-second buff: 10% lower Mana cost and 10% more damage on your damaging abilities. Blizzard says periodic effects do not benefit and channels do, so Arcane MissilesArcane MissilesLevel 8 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost85 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration3 secLaunches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 25 Arcane damage each second for 3 sec. counts; the Mage tooltip does not spell out the periodic exclusion that other classes' copies do.

Horde — Orc is new to Mage in Forever. Blood FuryBlood FuryTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec. gives +10% spell power on a 2-minute cooldown, so it is finally a caster racial. Command does nothing for a Mage: it only buffs Hunter and Warlock pets.

Skyborne Mage is Alliance-only. Troll's BerserkingBerserkingTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration10 sec is now a flat +10% cast speed for 15 seconds, and Undead's CannibalizeCannibalizeTalentCastInstantRangeMeleeCooldown120 sec cooldownWhen activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect. restores mana as well as health.

Quality of life

  • Conjured water is free drink from level 4, upgrading through the gem ladder, so there is never a reason to buy it.
  • Teleports come from a separate portal trainer standing near your class trainer, and every teleport consumes a Rune of Teleportation at about nine and a half silver. Slow FallSlow FallLevel 12 · Spell · ArcaneCastInstantCost40 ManaDuration30 secSlows falling speed for 30 sec. eats a Light Feather per cast, so carry a stack of both.
  • Loot scrolls, and pick up books from level 6. Blizzard calls Comprehension a Mage-only minor tradeskill for deciphering scrolls dropped by creatures, and says of the rewards only that "players will discover in their adventures". Comprehend ScrollComprehend ScrollSpell · PhysicalCastInstantRangeMeleeDecipher an untranslated scroll. sits in the General tab of your spellbook, and failing to decipher a scroll turns you into a sheep until your skill improves. The separate Research system is described by the guide sites and the client, and absent from Blizzard's deep dive. It unlocks from finding books in the world and returning them to librarians, and pays a ring for twenty donations and a pendant from its quest. (Blizzard listed a beta known issue that could lock Mages out of Research after learning it. If that happens to you it is a bug, not something you did.)
  • Comprehension scrolls cannot be cast while moving. Budget the stand-still time like any other cast.
  • Get a wand early and use it instead of Fire BlastFire BlastLevel 6 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost40 ManaRange20 yd rangeCooldown8 sec cooldownBlasts the enemy for 27 to 35 Fire damage..
  • Respeccing means a class trainer in a major city, Blizzard's stated route for Legacy talents too. Dual Specialization arrives at level 40; below it you pay for every reset.

At level 60

Nothing above 30 was played in the beta, so this is what the launch client shows rather than what players have found. Each tree's 31-point capstone arrives at level 40: Arcane PowerArcane PowerTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration15 secFor the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast., CombustionCombustionLevel 40 · Spell · FireCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledWhen activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells. and Ice BarrierIce BarrierLevel 40 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost305 ManaCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration60 secShield yourself, absorbing 448 damage and increasing your Frost damage by 3% for 60 sec. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 3% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.. Whether Arcane's new engine holds up, whether Fire takes over once Pyroblast is usable, and how far the scroll system goes are all still open. Raids open December 9.
